rows.quote: To investigate potential mediating pathways through which BPS-targeted proteins might contribute to depression, multi-omics data were integrated, including proteome-wide association study datasets from the FINNGEN biobank, the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project, and the Icelandic deCODE consortium, as well as human plasma metabolomic datasets.
rows.coder_note: Reread: sentence names the FINNGEN biobank among the proteome-wide association datasets; no pqtl-side dictionary row is for FinnGen.
Reread: the one sentence names the Icelandic deCODE consortium without N, platform, year or citation; two dictionary rows are deCODE protein releases.
Reread: the one sentence names the project without cohort subset, N, platform, year or citation; several dictionary rows are releases of it.
